text:
marissa: kicking off canary for the p95-driven mini-batcher on route=chat.completion, tier=standard. Target p95=120ms, initial token_budget=80 -> rolling to 10% :rocket:
kevin: noticed p95 climbed to ~148ms at the 10% mark on one host group (g4dn-like). CPU flat, GPU utilization fine. Repro locally with trace enabled. :thinking_face:
beth: can you paste the trace? my hunch is kernel handoff cost + KV cache miss pattern for large prefixes.
kevin: attaching short excerpt from traces (flattened):
```
# timeline snippet
0.00ms accept
2.6ms enqueue
5.2ms microbatch assemble
27.4ms kernel switch (fp16->int8 path)
36.1ms kv-fetch (miss)
112.8ms token emit
```
anish: that kernel switch jump is suspicious. We recently changed the kernel selector heuristic to prefer quantized kernels for sequences > 512 tokens. Maybe the canary hit a mixed-length workload and we paid a conversion penalty.
marissa: good catch. route has mixed short-chat + long-context searches in one slot. We should gate quantized kernel selection behind batch homogeneity check for now. Can we simulate with our batch sampler?
jonah: I ran an offline sampler replay for 30 mins with the same traffic; when we force-hold kernel preference (no quant switch) p95 -> 118ms, throughput same. With adaptive quant switching p95 -> 145ms and more variance.
perf-bot: perf/regression alert: eng-runtime canary 3920012345 flagged p95 delta +25% vs baseline on route=chat.completion at 10% traffic.
beth: KV-cache metrics: kv_hit_rate dropped from 0.87 -> 0.74 during canary window. There was a burst of cold-start prefixes; maybe prefix eviction policy interacting with the new batching window.
kevin: proposing action: 1) pause kernel auto-switch in canary (revert selector commit) 2) tighten batch homogeneity (require seq_len stddev < 40 tokens) 3) increase token_budget to 120 for tier=standard to reduce microbatch churn. Thoughts?
anish: +1 for pausing selector. But increasing token_budget may increase latency tail for short requests. Instead prefer dynamic token_budget by route: short-chat routes keep budget=60, long-context get 120. We already have tagging by route/tier, just need rollout flag.
marissa: agreed. Implement route-scoped token targets and revert kernel selector on canary hosts, roll to 20% after metric stabilization. I'll assign follow-ups. @deploy-bot can you rollback selector on the 10% canary group?
deploy-bot: rollback started for canary group id=cr-3920012345-selector, ETA ~90s.
kevin: monitoring dashboards show p95 starting to drop back to ~122ms after rollback. KV-hit_rate recovering.
marissa: great. postmortem action items: update kernel selector to consult batch composition, add unit test for mixed-length workload, refine eviction policy to avoid thundering prefix evictions, and add canary guard that checks kv_hit_rate delta < 5% before kernel switch. I'll write up a short PR. :memo:
jonah: I can own the unit tests and replay harness. tagging this thread for follow-up in next perf sync. :+1:
